subject: shinyapps.io, animation package, iframes and jquery

messages.author: 14159511dd34761d
messages.subject: shinyapps.io, animation package, iframes and jquery
parts:
My application runs a computation and then runs 'animation' package to produce an animation, which is then served in iframe. Everything works locally and as far as I can tell all files (html, js, css, etc) are produced on shinyapps.io as well. However the iframe is served empty because of the following error:

TypeError: $(...).on is not a function () (shiny-server-pro.js:15)
 $('body').on('click', 'a', function(ev){

As far as I understand it is caused by:

1. shiny-server-pro.js is injected into my iframe whether I use

     iframe.tag <- paste("<iframe src=\"", file.name,"\" width=\"1200\"  frameborder=\"0\" height=\"700\"></iframe>", sep="")
     HTML(iframe.tag)
 
     or   
 
     tags$iframe(src=file.name, style="width: 1200px; height: 700px")
     

2. Animation package uses an older version of jquery (1.4.4), which is not compatible with shiny-server-pro.js (and shiny-server-pro.js does not inject it's own jquery),


Is there a way to avoid having in shiny-server-pro.js in iframe, or have some other workaround?

The app itself is here https://focus-ml.shinyapps.io/clustering/

messages.author: 14159511dd34761d
messages.subject: Re: shinyapps.io, animation package, iframes and jquery
parts: Jeff, I cannot really say anything about this error. One suggestion, which you probably have already considered: add a suitable jquery lib for shiny-server.js and shiny-server-pro.js using the compatibility mode: http://learn.jquery.com/using-jquery-core/avoid-conflicts-other-libraries . This would require changes to both scripts but will shield them from any custom scripts that an iframe uses.
